articles.title: What makes earthquakes so deadly?
articles.summary: Colombia and neighboring Venezuela have been struck by devastating earthquakes recently. Colombia experienced a strong quake killing at least 250 people, coming weeks after twin quakes in Venezuela caused over 6,000 fatalities. This series of natural disasters underscores the immense humanitarian challenges and urgent need for disaster relief in the South American region, impacting livelihoods and infrastructure significantly.

articles.title: China rejects US-led statement on missile test notification, warns against 'political manipulation'
